offers.title: Reserve a pay-later hotel
offers.prompt: Find the cheapest pay-later Hotels.com stay in Manila from 2026-10-18 to 2026-10-22 for 2 adults with free cancellation, and open the reservation checkout.
offers.description: Opens Hotels.com so the traveler can sign in, then searches that account for a free-cancellation pay-later stay and opens checkout for the cheapest match.
offers.deliverable: Property name, price, free-cancellation status, and the Hotels.com checkout URL.

outputs.text: Sulit Hotel Manila, $83, free cancellation, checkout opened for 18-22 Oct 2026.
